payload.claim: The claim sentence enumerating the witness's seven refused edits is dense enough to misread as describing eight cases ("at the end of a file, and before a blank line and a line of lesser indent" first scans as three separate cases, plus three "Others" cases, plus the final "One adds nothing, and one adds a comment" pair, totaling eight). It only resolves to the stated seven once "before a blank line and a line of lesser indent" is read as a single combined scenario (blank line skipped, then a lesser-indented kept line reached). The arithmetic is internally consistent once parsed correctly — the sixteen-None and twenty-two-wrong-version counts both check out exactly — so this is not a defect in the rule itself, only in how easily the prose is miscounted on a first read.
